summary: Structural twin of the other LinkedListNodeInsertion with different secondary-list geometry. A tagged 12-byte node (payload=a2, tag=1) is allocated and appended to the first linked list (head this+0x0, tail this+0x4, anchor this+0x8, count this+0xC). The second linked list (head this+0x10, anchor this+0x14/+0x18, count this+0x1C) is only built when a3 is zero, producing at most two nodes at base value *a2 plus a 1016-byte running stride; nodes whose computed value is zero are skipped. Used for vehicle instance list nodes.

local_names.this: list container object (two linked lists of 12-byte nodes)
local_names.a2: first-list payload value and base value for the second-list stride series
local_names.a3: count selector byte: non-zero -> no secondary nodes, zero -> 2

operations.description: If a2 is null, skip the entire first-list insertion section.
Allocate a 12-byte node for the first list with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12); on success initialize node[0]=a2, node[4]=0, node[8]=1 (tag 1).

Append the node to the first list: if the head this[0] is non-null, point the old tail's next field (this[1]+4) at the node; otherwise set head this[0] and anchor this[2] to the node. Then set tail this[1] to the node and increment the count this[3].
Set the secondary-list iteration count to 0 when a3 is non-zero, otherwise 2; the secondary section runs only when this count is non-zero.
Loop over the secondary count (2 when a3==0); each step computes the node value v8 = v7 + *v3 with the stride accumulator v7 advancing by 1016 and *v3 re-read from a2 each iteration.
When the computed value v8 is non-zero, allocate a 12-byte secondary-list node with OperatorNewNhMallocWrapper(12); on success initialize node[0]=v8, node[4]=0, node[8]=0 (tag 0).

Link the secondary node at the front of the second list: if the head this[4] is non-null, set new-node next (v9+4) to the old head; otherwise set both anchors this[5] and this[6] to the node. Then set head this[4] to the node and increment the count this[7].
Return the loop counter, which reaches 0 when the secondary loop completes. Invoked from VehicleInstanceListBuilder (0x004B5C50) to build vehicle instance list nodes.

clean_pseudocode: if (*this) *(this[1]+4) = node; else { *this = node; this[2] = node; }
if (this[4]) *(n+4) = this[4]; else { this[5] = n; this[6] = n; }
